workarounds.symptom: Dashboard: crypto.randomUUID is not a function on non-HTTPS self-hosted origins
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(ui): support UUID generation on HTTP origins. Target files: apps/ui/src/api/hooks/use-fleet-report.test.ts, apps/ui/src/api/hooks/use-fleet-report.ts, apps/ui/src/api/hooks/use-notification-events.ts. **Why:** Self-hosted HTTP dashboards can submit fleet report subscriptions and other UUID-backed actions when the browser does not expose `crypto.randomUUID`. . (Ref: https://github.com/desplega-ai/agent-swarm/pull/3031)
